messages.subject: constraints on linear fixed effects
parts:
Hi all,

Is there anyway in inla to impose a >1 (for all fixed effect coeffs) and sum to 1 (or N) constraint on the fixed effect coefficients? This can approximately be achieved using the clinear function in the range {0,1} but it would be nice to hard code the constraints.

Thanks for the help!

Sam

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] constraints on linear fixed effects
parts:
On Tue, 2016-01-12 at 05:09 -0800, Samir Bhatt wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> Is there anyway in inla to impose a >1 (for all fixed effect coeffs)
> and sum to 1 (or N) constraint on the fixed effect coefficients? This
> can approximately be achieved using the clinear function in the range
> {0,1} but it would be nice to hard code the constraints.

the 'clinear' model can impose constraints, but the bi-effect is that
this parameter goes into the hyperparameters not the latent field. 

there is no way to make these (constrained) coofs sum to 1 or some
other value. 

if you use unconstrained fixed effects, then these can be constrainted
to sum to 1, say. 

H
